description.fr-FR: Les lettres de Bérulle imprimées par Migne : aux carmélites, aux Pères de l’Oratoire, à diverses personnes, sur le mariage d’Henriette de France, et des fragments.
description.en-US: Bérulle’s letters as printed by Migne: to the Carmelite nuns, to the Fathers of the Oratory, to various people, on the marriage of Henrietta Maria, and fragments.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Bérulle impressas por Migne: às carmelitas, aos Padres do Oratório, a diversas pessoas, sobre o casamento de Henriqueta Maria, e fragmentos.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du cardinal de Bérulle, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856 (reprint of Bourgoing’s 1644 collected edition); archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors, merged columns and some chapter openings the scan lost remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Bérulle died in 1629; the 1856 edition is public domain.

title.fr-FR: Lettres relatives au mariage d’Henriette de France
